title: Smart Data Models - Agrifood / AgriPlantSample
description: A physical sample of plant tissue (for example leaves) taken from one plant, from a set of marked plants or as a composite over a zone or parcel, together with its laboratory results on a dry-matter basis.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity Type. It has to be AgriPlantSample

location.description: GeoProperty. Where the sample was taken: the plant position, or a Polygon for a composite over an area

hasAgriPlant.description: Relationship. Plant or plants the sample was taken from. Several plants for a composite of marked plants

hasAgriManagementZone.description: Relationship. Management zone the sample represents, for composite samples per zone

hasAgriParcel.description: Relationship. Parcel the sample represents or was taken in

plantTissue.description: Property. Enum:'leaf, petiole, fruit, flower, shoot, wholePlant, other'. Plant tissue that was sampled

phenologicalStage.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Phenological stage of the plant at sampling time, preferably as a BBCH code

dateSampled.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the sample was taken in the field

dateAnalysed.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Date and time when the laboratory analysed the sample

numberOfSubsamples.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Integer'. Number of organs or subsamples mixed into the sample, for example the number of leaves

sampleCode.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Code that identifies the sample at the laboratory

laboratory.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the laboratory that analysed the sample

analysisMethod.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Default analytical method or standard applied to the sample as a whole

nitrogen.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Nitrogen content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

phosphorus.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Phosphorus content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

potassium.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Potassium content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

calcium.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Calcium content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

magnesium.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Magnesium content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

sulphur.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Sulphur content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

chloride.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Chloride content of the dry matter, as a fraction between 0 and 1

iron.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Iron content of the dry matter

manganese.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Manganese content of the dry matter

zinc.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Zinc content of the dry matter

copper.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Copper content of the dry matter

boron.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Boron content of the dry matter

sodium.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Units:'mg/kg'. Sodium content of the dry matter

parameter.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Name of the measured parameter

value.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. Measured value of the parameter

unitCode.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/unitCode'. Unit of the value as a UN/CEFACT common code

method.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Analytical method used for this parameter

otherResults.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/ItemList'. Results of parameters that have no dedicated property, each with its unit and method
